description: This file defines the 'Install' model class responsible for setting up the database schema and initial data during the installation process of an OpenCart project.

classes.name: Install
classes.description: A class extending the system's base model to perform database schema creation and initial data seeding during installation.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Sets up the database schema by dropping existing tables, creating new ones according to schema definitions, and inserting initial data such as admin user, settings, and API keys.
